title: Forward Sweep Beyond the Stored Zone
statement: Let $A$ be a type, $x$ a finite word over $A$, $q$ an optional state, $q'$ a state, $p$ an input-head position for $x$, $z$ an integer frontier, $l,r$ finite stacks of possibly blank symbols, $out$ an output word, and $b$ a possibly blank symbol. Applying the action that writes $b$, moves the work head right, leaves the input head stationary, emits nothing, and enters $q'$ yields the configuration with state $q'$, frontier $z+1$, left stack $b::l$, right stack the tail of $r$, and the same input-head position and output.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and the state type $S$ are types
$q$ is an optional state and $q'$ is a state
$l,r$ are lists of possibly blank symbols
replaced:
Consider the forward-sweep configuration of a one-work-tape machine with
(optional) state $q$, input-head position $p$, frontier $z$, left stack $l$,
an \emph{arbitrary} (possibly empty) right stack $r$, and output word
$\mathit{out}$. Applying the local sweep action that writes the
possibly-blank symbol $b$, moves the work head right, and enters state $q'$
produces the forward-sweep configuration with state $q'$, the same input-head
position and output, frontier $z + 1$, left stack $b \mathbin{::} l$, and
right stack the tail of $r$; when $r$ is empty, the cell consumed is a blank
beyond the stored zone.
